reason: The hypothesis proposes a specific, testable mechanism—temperature-induced structural compromise (cracking/transformation) of the native passive film leading to a transition from uniform to localized corrosion—that is not stated in any passage. While the passages separately mention passive film protection, film rupture, chloride pitting, and temperature effects on passivation in alkaline solutions, none combine these into a prediction that elevated temperature in a chloride environment degrades the pre-existing air-formed film to accelerate pitting. The controlled two-temperature comparison to isolate this mechanism is also new.
